name: media_streams
description: Stream and manage open-source television, radio and self-hosted media. Search the IPTV-org channel catalogue and the Radio-Browser station directory by country, language, category or codec; play a stream in Stella's own media surface or hand it to an external player when the codec is missing; record a stream to disk with a bounded duration; import, dedupe and export the user's own M3U playlists and personal station list; and connect to the user's own Jellyfin, Icecast or LibreTime servers over loopback. States honestly that a source is a community list whose legality varies by country, and never bundles content or circumvents DRM.

operation.description: One of: tv_search | tv_channels | radio_search | tv_play | radio_play | stop | pause | volume | record | library | servers | now_playing | sources. Defaults to tv_search.

query.description: Free-text search: a channel or station name, a country, a language, or a tag (e.g. 'news', 'jazz', 'sports').

language.description: Language filter for channels or stations (e.g. 'english', 'hindi', 'malayalam').

limit.description: Maximum entries to return. Defaults to 20.

channel.description: Channel id, name, or the stream URL itself for playback.

station.description: Station name or URL for playback.

url.description: Explicit stream URL. Always used verbatim - never resolved or guessed.

duration_seconds.description: Recording length in seconds. Defaults to 300, capped at 3600.

confirm.description: Must be true to write a recording to disk. Defaults to false (dry run).

action.description: For library and servers operations: import | export | list | add | remove | refresh (library); list | status | play | connect (servers).

path.description: Path to an M3U playlist file for the library import action.

volume.description: Output volume percentage (0-100) for the volume operation.

target.description: Output device name for the volume operation. Defaults to the selected audio output.

author: Stella
notes: Sources: IPTV-org public channel database (index.m3u + channels.json), Radio Browser community database, Jellyfin/Icecast/LibreTime user-configured servers, VLC/ffmpeg optional for capture. No content is bundled; no DRM is circumvented.
